question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

**PREVAIL**
solution:
The correct answer is **"surrender"** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Look at the meaning of the given word:
 
 
• **Prevail:**- Win, triumph, and prove to be more powerful and superior.
 
 
 
• Look at the meanings of the words in the options
 
 
• **Surrender**- to give up.
 
• **control**- command, dominance
 
• **prove**- demonstrate the existence of something
 
• **succeed-** to win, triumph.
 
 
 
• As we can see **Prevail** is the **opposite** of **surrender**.
 
• Hence, *the correct answer will be **"surrender"***.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Look at the synonyms and antonyms of prevail:
 
 
• 
 
 
 

 **Synonyms**
 **Antonyms**
 
 

 win, conquer, succeed, triumph
 surrender, give up, give in
